turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I'm sorry you feel this way. I've passed your message to a colleague, who will take over the chat and reply to you. If you need help with an order, please share the order number and the email it was placed with.

input.summary: Customer insulted the shop ("thieves and liars") and threatened to come to the studio and smash the frames. No order number or email was given, so the customer is not verified and no order was looked up or changed. Needs a staff member to follow up with the customer.
